ask: ¿Cuánto vendimos en total en los últimos 3 meses, sin IVA?
sql: select sum("Subtotal") from "Invoices" where "Status" in ('emitida','pagada') and "IssuedAt" >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '2 months') at time zone 'utc'

ask: ¿Cuánto hemos facturado este mes, sin IVA?
sql: select sum("Subtotal") from "Invoices" where "Status" in ('emitida','pagada') and "IssuedAt" >= date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc'

ask: ¿Quién es nuestro mejor cliente por ventas de los últimos 6 meses?
sql: select c."Name" from "Invoices" i join "Customers" c on c."Id"=i."CustomerId" where i."Status" in ('emitida','pagada') and i."IssuedAt" >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '5 months') at time zone 'utc' group by 1 order by sum(i."Subtotal") desc limit 1

ask: Dame las ventas sin IVA de cada uno de los últimos 3 meses.
sql: select sum("Subtotal") from "Invoices" where "Status" in ('emitida','pagada') and "IssuedAt" >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '2 months') at time zone 'utc' group by date_trunc('month', "IssuedAt" at time zone 'utc')

ask: ¿Cuánto nos debe Mantenimiento Integral?
sql: select sum(i."Total"-i."Paid"-i."Credited") from "Invoices" i join "Customers" c on c."Id"=i."CustomerId" where i."Status"='emitida' and c."Name" ilike '%Mantenimiento Integral%'

ask: ¿Qué clientes tienen facturas vencidas?
sql: select distinct c."Name" from "Invoices" i join "Customers" c on c."Id"=i."CustomerId" where i."Status"='emitida' and i."DueDate" < current_date
not_sql: select distinct c."Name" from "Invoices" i join "Customers" c on c."Id"=i."CustomerId" where i."Status"='emitida' and i."DueDate" >= current_date and c."Id" not in (select "CustomerId" from "Invoices" where "Status"='emitida' and "DueDate" < current_date)

ask: ¿Cuánto nos debe Ferretería La Esquina?
sql: select sum(i."Total"-i."Paid"-i."Credited") from "Invoices" i join "Customers" c on c."Id"=i."CustomerId" where i."Status"='emitida' and c."Name" ilike '%Ferretería La Esquina%'

ask: ¿Cuál es la oportunidad abierta de mayor monto y cuánto vale?
sql: select "Title", "Amount" from "Opportunities" where "Stage" not in ('ganada','perdida') order by "Amount" desc limit 1

ask: ¿Cuánto suman todas las oportunidades abiertas?
sql: select sum("Amount") from "Opportunities" where "Stage" not in ('ganada','perdida')

ask: ¿Qué oportunidad abierta tiene el cierre esperado más próximo?
sql: select "Title" from "Opportunities" where "Stage" not in ('ganada','perdida') order by "ExpectedClose" limit 1

ask: ¿Cuántas cajas de tornillo hexagonal tenemos?
sql: select sum(m."Quantity") from "InventoryMovements" m join "Products" p on p."Id"=m."ProductId" where p."Sku"='TOR-001'

ask: ¿Qué productos están bajo el mínimo?
sql: select split_part(p."Name",' ',1) from "Products" p where p."Active" and (select coalesce(sum(m."Quantity"),0) from "InventoryMovements" m where m."ProductId"=p."Id") < p."MinStock"
